author: Hendler, 2005

note.en: A small spiny brittle star known from the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica and Panama; known here from museum collections. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura espinosa pequeña descrita del Caribe de Costa Rica y Panamá; conocida aquí por colecciones de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 52 records in the region (many are museum specimens)
WoRMS gives the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica and Panama as range

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range
